nodes.text: Day shift. Off it, technically, so make it short or make it a drink.

choices.text: How deep do the workings go?

nodes.text: Mithril by lamplight, tally-string on the wrist, a knot going down and a knot coming up. When the strings match, the horn stays quiet. You learn to love a quiet horn the way farmers love dull weather.

Deeper than anybody is paid to think about. The night crews say the Hewers never stopped working, that you can put your ear to the old faces and hear it. I say stone settles and echoes lie. I also say I do not work nights, and I have never once asked to.
Knot going down, knot coming up. That is the whole trade, and it is enough.
